test: NativeProofLocationOracleTests (four executed tests, six recorded outcomes)
verified: Opposing bay conversion is free, keeps characters in place, and leaves the old site supporting.
A new Tatooine bay contributes to Light's next generation; available Reserve cards still cap actual activation.
Two-character transit charges a single source fare (Dark free, Light 1). Guards cannot join, and moved characters cannot transit again.
Control Room deploys a new bay or converts an existing bay from Reserve. Successful searches can repeat.
After both legal bays deploy, an unsuccessful search lets both players verify Reserve and prevents the same search for the rest of the turn.
limitations: Initial zones are fixture setup. Transit fixture imports the already-covered Light bay into Lost in the GEMP harness; it does not compare that card's zone or full pile equality for this branch. The conversion test itself exercises real GEMP conversion.
Native and GEMP shuffle orders are intentionally independent. Tests compare card conservation, search outcomes and persistence, not RNG parity.
No complete legal-choice equivalence or full starter matches claimed. Vehicles, passengers, pilots, other worlds, generic sites and other location text remain gated.
